sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This is a strong fixture on paper for the leaders, as Alsager Town sit bottom with just 4 points and arrive in poor form (W-L-L-L-L-L). Despite Sandbach's recent loss, they remain unbeaten over their longer record and will be looking to bounce back and maintain their position at the summit.
divisionWide: Saturday's 10-fixture slate presents several key battles across the division. Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in what could be a crucial points opportunity, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a direct clash between two in-form sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth, visit Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter. Foley Meir face Bilston Town (fifth) in what shapes as competitive, while Barnton travel to Shawbury United to face a struggling side on a six-game losing run. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a battle of sides seeking consistency, Crewe welcome Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town (both bottom-half clubs), and Widnes Town, pointless with 7 games played, travel to Brereton Social. Midweek, Brereton Social then host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45, adding another fixture to monitor.
